Why can’t Trump persuade US women to have more children? The Trump administration and wider Maga movement have sounded the alarm on declining birthrates in America, which they blame on women’s higher education, career choices and the decline of the nuclear family. Seventy years ago, at the peak of the baby boom, the average American woman gave birth to 3.6 children. Today, after decades of decline, that number is 1.6. For the population to remain stable, it needs to be 2.1. Louise Callaghan explores the real reasons why families in America are turning their back on Trump’s “pro-family” coalition, resulting in a sharp fall in births #trump #news #fertility #unitedstates #motherhood
